title: OS Command Injection in InputValidationsOSCMDInjectionMain2Activity
description: The application performs unsafe command execution by concatenating unsanitized user input from an EditText into a command string used by Runtime.exec(). This can lead to arbitrary command execution on the device.
impact: An attacker could execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the application, potentially leading to data theft, device compromise, or unauthorized access.
remediation: Avoid using Runtime.exec() with string concatenation. Instead, use a list of arguments to prevent shell interpretation, or use safer APIs for specific tasks like network connectivity checks.

metadata.why_not_already_detected: The finding was detected by the rule engine, but the specific sink-to-source flow (OS Command Injection) requires manual verification of the input source.
